_method: Measured on one RTX 3090 (24 GiB) + 94 GiB RAM, Linux. vram_gib: GPU memory in use with the model loaded minus the desktop's use just before loading (3.4-3.6 GiB: Xorg, browser). ram_gib: system RAM the model itself needs. LM Studio models are fully offloaded to the GPU, so no weights or KV cache are in RAM: 0 (the llama-server process adds about 0.3-0.4 GiB of runtime memory plus reclaimable file pages, whatever the model). Strata: the drop in used system RAM when its instance was stopped (its engine keeps MoE experts resident in RAM).
